_about: The workshops behind each merchant (build 51). Recipes never change. Times are in hours. Trinket and part recipes name junk materials from items.json (loot): a trinket takes one rare, one uncommon and the rest common; a part takes five, two of them rare. Build 52: every trinket gives two stats, its major line first and its minor line second; a trinket made of two damage stats is named after them in that order (Fire Ember Locket: Fire Resistance, then Ember Resistance), so its first name is its major stat and its second name its minor one. Its tier is its rarity (1 common to 4 legendary): the higher, the bigger its numbers. A trinket fits on any piece of gear or armor, one to a piece.
